source.comparisonDefinition: today closing price versus previous closing price

denominatorSemantics.notComparableExcludedReason: TWSE N/A includes prior-day no close, ex-right/ex-dividend, new listing or resumed trading; these are not ordinary return comparisons.
denominatorSemantics.unmatchedRule: Unmatched remains separate from comparable denominator unless a future schema explicitly defines otherwise.

keyCounterexample: TAIEX was +0.25% while comparable listed-stock decliners (506) exceeded advancers (483). Positive cap-weighted index return therefore does not imply positive stock-count breadth.
universeFirewall: Do not use TWSE Overall Market counts for stock breadth because they include non-stock security types such as warrants and ETFs.
Do not label this TWSE-only stock breadth as TWSE+TPEx combined breadth.
Do not compare this official stock denominator directly with System1 Formal-normalized todayRows without preserving both universe identifiers.
N/A is UNKNOWN/NOT_COMPARABLE for ordinary close-to-close breadth, not advance, decline or flat.
positiveMechanism: Advance/decline counts measure cross-sectional participation and can expose divergence hidden by capitalization-weighted index returns.
Official TWSE daily counts provide a direct Taiwan PIT source with explicit comparison semantics and stock-only column.
falsification: One-day advance/decline can reverse quickly and cannot by itself establish trend persistence.
Price-limit, ex-right/ex-dividend, listings/resumptions and unmatched states require explicit handling.
TWSE-only breadth may diverge from combined TWSE+TPEx or a strategy-specific eligible universe.
If Above-MA, equal-weight return and concentration controls explain the same state, one-day A/D may add little incremental value.
promotionReason: Official TWSE daily stock-only up/down/unchanged counts with explicit comparison and N/A semantics establish bounded Taiwan PIT feasibility. This is not evidence of predictive alpha.
exactNext: BR-040 repeat official TWSE stock breadth on independent dates and add TPEx/strategy-universe lanes without denominator mixing.
Join D09-04 with D09-05 Above-MA and D09-10 concentration only after each universe/source clock is explicit.
Test index-up/breadth-down and index-down/breadth-up states prospectively before any D09-12 regime promotion.
